plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-13 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Theatre Arts Education (BA/BS) program page and its linked official degree map, 'Theatre Arts & Theatre Arts Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'Theatre Arts Education (Campus)', last updated/reviewed August 3, 2026 (the workbook Index lists Online as N/A for this program). Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Collected as the BS with Secondary Licensure: the catalog prints 'Total Credits, BS Degree with Licensure: 120', which the map matches exactly (16/16/15/17/15.5/15/13.5/12); the catalog also prints BA Degree with Licensure 125 and BA/BS Degree with Minor 120, and the map's own note states that students electing the BA take 16 credits of one foreign language (not included in the map) and that students not electing Secondary Education Licensure complete a minor (18+ credits) instead. The map exercises the full catalog curriculum: Acting, Directing, and Theory Core 25 (including the Capstone slot, which exercises the catalog's Capstone Pathway: Pathway A - THEA 4751 Capstone (3 credits); or Pathway B - THEA 4752 Production Practicum Capstone (2 credits) AND THEA 4761 Production Capstone Symposium (1 credit), 3 credits in total.), Production & Design Core 17 (including two Supplemental Production slots), Teacher Education Core as itemized below, and the Professional Education Requirements for Secondary Licensure (Pre-Admission named courses EDUC 2100, EDUC 2200, EDUC 2400, SPED 2010, SCED 3180 at the map's 2 of its catalog 2-3 range, and SCED 3720; Block Courses SCED 3570/3590; Advanced Courses EDUC 4930 and student teaching at 9). Disclosed, transcribed as printed and not reconciled: (1) the catalog's Theatre Arts Education Curriculum heading prints 50 credits, but its three sub-cores itemize to 53 (25 + 17 + 11); (2) THEA 2900 Creative Dramatics is 1.5 credits in the catalog but 2 credits in the map, whose Fall Year 3 total of 15.5 uses the map figure, so the Teacher Education Core is exercised at 11.5 against the catalog's itemized 11; (3) the Professional Education Pre-Admission heading prints 18-19 credits while its listed course ranges sum to 18-20; the map exercises the catalog's generic 'Academic 3900/4900 - Methods Course(s)' slot through THEA 3950 Methods in Performing Arts Education, the major's own licensure methods course, counted once, per the catalog footnote that students who complete their teaching methods course as part of their major requirements count it there; that slot therefore serves both the Teacher Education Core's licensure option and the Pre-Admission methods requirement, and its non-licensure alternative in the catalog is 3 THEA credits approved by the department; (4) EDUC 4930 is titled 'Student Teaching Seminar' in the catalog but 'Student Teaching Practicum' in the map (the catalog title is recorded), and the map's THEA 4980 Student Teaching exercises the catalog's generic 'Academic 4980 - Student Teaching'. The map carries a banner in Spring Year 3: 'Apply to College of Education Teacher Preparation Program'. Per the catalog, all courses must be passed with a C (2.0) or better to be counted in the major; student assessment takes place annually through audition or portfolio review, and exit interviews are held for all graduating seniors.
